name: Bear with Shoulder Touches

instructions.description: Start in a high-plank position with your hands directly below your shoulders and your legs fully extended behind you. Keep your feet about hip-width apart and your core engaged.
Maintain a stable plank position and shift your weight slightly onto one arm. Lift the opposite hand and touch the opposite shoulder.
Place your hand back on the floor and shift your weight to the other side. Touch the opposite shoulder with the other hand.
Continue alternating sides in a slow, controlled manner. Keep your legs extended and your body stable throughout the movement.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.

commentsNotes: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core to prevent your hips from rocking or rotating.
Keep your shoulders stable and avoid shrugging.
Shift your weight smoothly before lifting each hand.
Widen your feet slightly if you need more stability.
